en: A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a European town nestled in a valley, with dense rows of gabled houses, church towers, and a prominent clock-tower building to the right. The foreground shows rooftops and trees; in the middle ground is a large church and other civic buildings; beyond are factories, fields, and low hills. The word "Waldheim." is printed in red at the top left, and along the left edge there is a vertical printer's credit in German mentioning Meissen.
